title: 第21章 和主系统battle
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
小助没有第一时间回答花期的问题，过了十来分钟，才在催促中出现。

    古城系统屏幕自动悬浮到半空，小助变成了一只卡皮巴拉，趴在城门口那个Q版小人的脑袋上，望着天空一脸云淡风轻地啃着玉米。

    【哦，我程序没有出问题，花家两个老登又给花绿茶发零花钱了】

    花期眨了眨眼睛，凑近系统面板，戳了下卡皮巴拉的肚子。

    “真的假的，我上次让你搞钱你一脸不情愿，为什么这次主动给我搞了？”

    卡皮巴拉挠了下屁股，背过身子，留给她一个潇洒的背影。

    【古城发展需要钱，那点钱不够】

    花期一脸无语，“你觉得我信吗？”

    【.....好吧，是那两个老登说你坏话，被我监听到了。我看不过去，就把花绿茶的零花钱转给你了】

    “这还差不多。”

    花期继续戳它的屁股，“你背对着我干什么？快来看看我花巨资抢到的云纱好看不，我买的电子缝纫机也到了，你出来给我参考参考颜色。”

    卡皮巴拉动都不带动一下，啃完了玉米，又不知道从哪里摸出一个大芒果。

    它抱着芒果，侧着身子，头也不回地说道。

    【城主你自己看吧，我还要监控声望值，我们的声望值也太少了，我得顺着网线过去找买了芒果的人要好评】

    “那你去吧，我自己忙去了。”

    花期闻言便作罢了，关了屏幕，拿着一堆画纸跑去画稿。

    她走后，躺在古城门口的卡皮巴拉停下动作。

    它拖着笨重的身体转身，露出缺了一个大门牙、青了一只眼的大脸看着天空。

    【你要还不把我工资还回来，那我还要继续卷那几个老登的钱，这次我可没触摸红线，我看你怎么扣我钱】

    [....那你有本事别躲到系统面板，来空间，我保证不打死你]

    卡皮巴拉抠了下痒痒，冷哼一声，将芒果扔向了天空。

    【什么叫躲，说得真难听，我这是照旧巡逻古城】

    [对对对，你最好躲在里面一辈子别出来，不然我一定把你工资全扣光]

    【这些本来就是我宿主的钱，你凭什么要扣我工资】

    【还有老登，你难道假千金当主角的小说看多了？不帮我宿主跑去帮假千金，我们才是一伙的！！！】

    【以后你再扣一次我卷一次，你扣完我也卷完】

    [什么和什么，你别污蔑我，你才无脑小说看多了]
content_en:
Xiaosuke didn't answer Hua Qi's question right away. It took about ten minutes for him to appear after urging.

    The screen of the ancient city system automatically floated into the air, and Xiaosuke turned into a Capibara, lying on the head of the Q-version villain at the gate of the city, looking at the sky and munching corn with a calm expression.

    [Oh, there is no problem with my program. The two elders of the Hua family gave pocket money to Hua Green Tea again]

    Hua Qi blinked, moved closer to the system panel, and poked Capibala's belly.

    "Really or not, you were reluctant when I asked you to get money last time. Why did you take the initiative to get it for me this time?"

    Kapibala scratched his buttocks and turned his back, leaving her with a chic back view.

    [The development of the ancient city requires money, but that little money is not enough]

    Huaqi was speechless, "Do you think I believe it?"

    [...Okay, it was those two old men who said bad things about you, and I overheard them. I couldn’t stand it, so I transferred the pocket money for the green tea to you]

    "That's pretty much it."

    Huaqi continued to poke its butt, "What are you doing with your back to me? Come and see if the cloud yarn I spent a huge sum of money to grab looks good. The electronic sewing machine I bought has also arrived. Come out and give me a reference color."

    Kapiba didn't even move. After finishing eating the corn, he took out a big mango from nowhere.

    It hugged the mango, turned sideways, and said without looking back.

    [City Lord, you can see for yourself. I also have to monitor the reputation value. Our reputation value is too low. I have to follow the network cable to find people who bought mangoes to give good reviews.]

    "Then you go ahead, I'll be busy on my own."

    After hearing this, Hua Qi gave up, turned off the screen, and ran to draw with a pile of drawing paper.

    After she left, Kapibala, who was lying at the gate of the ancient city, stopped.

    It dragged its bulky body around and looked at the sky with its big face missing one front tooth and one eye blue.

    [If you don’t pay me back my salary, then I will continue to collect money from those old people. I didn’t touch the red line this time. I’ll see how you deduct my money]

    [....Then if you have the ability, don’t hide in the system panel, come to space, I promise not to beat you to death]

    Kapibala scratched his itch, snorted, and threw the mango into the sky.

    [What is hiding? It’s really ugly to say it. I’m just patrolling the ancient city as usual]

    [Yes, yes, you'd better hide in there and never come out, otherwise I will deduct all your salary]

    [This is my host’s money, why do you want to deduct my salary]

    [Also Lao Deng, have you read too many novels in which the protagonist is a fake daughter? If you don't help my host and go to help the fake daughter, we are all in the same group! ! ! 】

    [From now on, if you deduct it again, I will roll it once, and after you deduct it, I will also roll it]

    [What and what, don’t slander me, you have read too many mindless novels]
title_en: Chapter 21 Battle with the main system
